lines.text: Hi! I´m Daniel. Welcome to Costa Rica!

Hi! Thanks, I'm Mike. 
What places can I visit in Costa Rica?
Well, it depends on how long you are staying. You can walk around San José and visit the Gold Museum or if you’re planning to stay a bit longer, there are plenty of places to visit in the provinces.
Let’s start with San José province!
Hi! I'm Daniel. Welcome to Costa Rica!

Hi! Thanks, I'm Lisa. 
What places can I visit in Costa Rica?
Well, it depends on how long you are staying. You can walk around San José and visit the Gold Museum or if you’re planning to stay a bit longer, there are plenty of places to visit in the provinces.
Let’s start with San José province!

Costa Rica is a volcanic country. Costa Rica is home of a great number of volcanoes. There are six active volcanoes and another 61 inactive or extinct ones.
For the past fifty years, Arenal was the country’s most active volcano. Although its eruptions haven't occurred. Arenal still is one of the country´s best known and most visited volcanoes.
There are, however, many other volcanoes, Poás Volcano, Turrialba Volcano. Both had activity in these past months.
